title: Electrosynthesis of a RuAg alloy for an efficient alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01350F, Communication
Tzung-Wen Chiou, Jia-Min Shen
A RuAg alloy with a FCC structure exhibited excellent HER activity, with an overpotential of 30 mV at 10 mA cm−2 in 1.0 M KOH solution.
